hooks.command: jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty" | { read -r f || exit 0; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; d=$(dirname "$f"); while [ "$d" != "/" ] && [ "$d" != "." ]; do if [ -f "$d/biome.jsonc" ]; then out=$(cd "$d" && npx --no-install biome check --write --no-errors-on-unmatched "$f" 2>&1) || { printf "%s\n" "$out" >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0; fi; d=$(dirname "$d"); done; }
